scope: Read complete Japanese premises/exchanges and all12 target sentence/task sets. Metadata/native/device approval excluded.
reviewCriteria: Ten minutes until departure, a specific interpretive question, anonymous opinion notes and returning a borrowed book are distinct actions.
Species versus an individual animal's name; lying down is an observed posture, not proof of sleep; retain the observation time.

Unify the approved revision used by all participants, not alter drawing geometry to make copies match. Pause instructions pending responsible-person confirmation; date of receipt alone is not proof of the valid revision.
Account number unchanged but holder name corrected; obtain a new form and contact the original person before proceeding; do not turn the exchange into verification or fraud guarantees.
